name: standing arms flinging
description: Open and close your arms in a relaxed fling to loosen the chest and shoulders. Handy as a quick warm-up.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
